issues: All nodes use plain rounded rectangles with no icon/shape differentiation, despite the prompt specifying icon styles for View 1 (image), View 2 (audio), View 3 (text), View-Specific Evidence (scale), Opinion Construction (chat), Conflictive Aggregation (merge), and Decision + Reliability (check). The diagram fails to visually encode node semantics.

The three input views are stacked vertically and all converge on a single 'View-Specific Evidence' node, which visually implies a single shared evidence node rather than per-view evidence construction. Consider three parallel evidence nodes or a clearer fan-in representation.

The annotation 'common vs view-specific reliability' is placed below the Conflictive Aggregation node but outside the Fusion group boundary (group ends at y=320, annotation starts at y=310 and extends to y=330), causing it to visually float outside its logical group.
The Fusion group (x=440, width=360) ends at x=800, but the Decision + Reliability node at x=860 sits outside any group, leaving the output node ungrouped and visually disconnected from the pipeline.
Edge from Conflictive Aggregation to Decision + Reliability crosses the Fusion group boundary without any visual cue (e.g., a port or label) indicating the transition from fusion to output.
The Inputs group is 300px wide but contains only 100px-wide nodes, leaving excessive whitespace on the right side of the group and creating an unbalanced composition.
No edge labels or data-flow annotations are present, making it unclear what type of information flows between stages (e.g., evidence vectors, opinion scores, reliability weights).

The vertical stacking of View 1, View 2, View 3 with equal spacing is acceptable, but the Fusion nodes are also stacked vertically, creating a monotonous grid-like layout that does not emphasize the pipeline's logical flow from inputs to output.

icon_feedback.why: Currently a plain rounded rectangle. Should use an image-related icon (e.g., the Azure Image style or a simple image glyph) to visually indicate this is an image view. Avoid the AWS EC2 Image Builder icon as it is too cloud-specific and toy-like for an academic architecture diagram.

Currently a plain rounded rectangle. The available audio icons (2-conductor jack/plug) are electrical-engineering symbols and inappropriate for an academic ML diagram. Use a simple speaker or waveform glyph instead, or drop the icon and use a text label with a small audio symbol.

Currently a plain rounded rectangle. The available text icons (Alphanumeric, Bulleted List) are mockup/UI elements and not suitable for a data-modality indicator. Use a simple 'T' or document glyph, or drop the icon and rely on the label.

Currently a plain rounded rectangle. The available scale icons (GCP Bucket Scale, Check Scale, Defender Industrial Scale System) are cloud-provider-specific and visually heavy. A simple balance/scale glyph or a bar-chart icon would better convey 'evidence' in an academic context.

Currently a plain rounded rectangle. The available chat icons (iOS chat, AWS chat, sitemap chat) are messaging-oriented and misleading for 'opinion construction' in a multi-view learning context. Use a thought-bubble or document-with-pen glyph, or drop the icon.

Currently a plain rounded rectangle. The available merge icons include a UML decision rhombus and a flowchart merge/storage shape, which are semantically closer but still generic. A custom conflict/merge glyph (e.g., two arrows converging with a lightning bolt) would be more appropriate. The Azure Defender Marquee is irrelevant.

Currently a plain rounded rectangle. The available check icons (iOS check, GCP check, hexagon check) are too simplistic and imply a boolean yes/no rather than a decision with reliability. Use a gauge or confidence-meter glyph, or a checkmark combined with a percentage indicator.
